ext_description.message: A desktop interface layer for Bilibili on Chromium and Edge, with unified navigation, content layouts, and themes while preserving Bilibili's native player and interactions.

style_original.message: Switch to the original YouTube Desktop style

subscriptions_login_hint.message: Log in to see recent subscriptions

search_subtitle.message: Videos, creators, anime, and TV & film from Bilibili

watch_later_summary.message: $COUNT$ videos · Bilibili watch progress is preserved

favorite_empty.message: This favorite list has no available videos

search_unavailable.message: Search is temporarily unavailable; the current page results are being kept as a fallback

history_login_error.message: Log in to view your watch history

history_load_error.message: Unable to load watch history. Use the button on the right to open Bilibili's native history manager

dynamic_login_error.message: Log in to view your updates

space_unavailable.message: Creator uploads are temporarily unavailable; the Bilibili page data is kept as a fallback

style_switched_original.message: Switched to the original YouTube Desktop style

native_action_hint.message: Use Bilibili's native action controls on this page

clear_history_description.message: This will clear all Bilibili watch history. This action cannot be undone.

unsupported_home_category.message: This home category is not supported

favorite_missing_aid.message: Favorite action is missing the video aid

appearance_desc.message: Control the extension state, surface material, and shared theme.

enabled_desc.message: Turn this off to restore the original Bilibili page.

glass_mode_desc.message: Switch between the frosted-glass interface and the original YouTube Desktop style without disabling BiliTube.

theme_desc.message: Apply the theme to the top bar, sidebar, and BiliTube-rendered pages.

navigation_desc.message: Control the YouTube-style guide and subscription list.

sidebar_collapsed_desc.message: Use a 72px compact guide on rendered pages; native pages still open the drawer from the menu.

show_subscriptions_desc.message: Show recent creators and live status in the left guide.

home_desc.message: Choose which Bilibili shelves appear in the YouTube-style recommendation feed.

home_followed_desc.message: Show a shelf of updates from creators you follow.

home_bangumi_desc.message: Show a shelf of recently updated anime.

home_popular_desc.message: Show a shelf of popular videos.

playback_desc.message: Playback interactions remain native to Bilibili; BiliTube provides card previews.

hover_preview_desc.message: Play a muted preview on thumbnail hover while keeping the seek rail available.

preview_delay_desc.message: Avoid repeated video requests when moving quickly across cards.

watch_later_quick_desc.message: Show a YouTube-style clock button in the top-right of hovered thumbnails.

interaction_desc.message: Control content density and animation feedback without changing native player controls.

density_desc.message: Compact mode reduces card spacing, guide row height, and empty space.

motion_desc.message: Choose full, subtle, or disabled BiliTube transitions and hover animations.

cards_desc.message: Choose supporting information shown on recommendation, search, and channel cards.

show_author_desc.message: Show creator avatars and names; titles and thumbnails remain when disabled.

show_meta_desc.message: Show view counts, publish times, and other card metadata.

search_desc.message: Keep Bilibili's official search structure and present results in a YouTube-style layout.

search_suggestions_desc.message: Show Bilibili suggestions about 180ms after text input.

content_desc.message: Control how BiliTube handles non-core page content.

hide_ads_desc.message: Hide recognized Bilibili ad cards and banners without affecting ordinary recommendations.

native_first_description.message: The player, creator controls, likes, coins, favorites, sharing, description, comments, and related videos remain in Bilibili's original DOM. BiliTube only provides the outer YouTube Desktop layout and safe visual styling.

settings_saved.message: Saved. Open Bilibili pages will update automatically

settings_intro.message: Adjust BiliTube's YouTube Desktop-inspired appearance and behavior on Bilibili.
